_doc: Write-ownership lane manifest (issue #431, hardened in #583).
Machine-checkable contract for the saga / mission-control / deploy ship-ceremony seam:
each plugin declares which sensitive `gh` subcommands its checked-in scripts may invoke.
scripts/check_ownership_lanes.py statically scans every declared plugin's scripts and fails
CI when a script reaches across into another plugin's owned mutation surface (e.g. a
deploy-lane script calling `gh issue create`, which is mission-control's domain).
This gate covers the WRITE-mutation subset of CLAUDE.md Development Workflow step 6; it does
NOT build the richer positive-ack handoff protocol (out of scope, tracked separately).
Extending it: add the plugin under `lanes` with its allowed_gh_subcommands, or add a path
prefix under `reserved_api_paths` to reserve a `gh api <path>` surface to one owner. Only
subcommands listed in `sensitive_subcommands` are enforced; subcommands outside that list
(gh repo view, gh auth status, gh search) are never policed.
Enforcement is VERB-AWARE (#583): benign read verbs (view, list, status, diff, checks,
download, get, watch) are permitted across lanes, so a direct-literal `gh issue view` from
saga is clean while `gh issue create` is not.
Attribution covers direct `gh` command literals, list concatenation onto ["gh"], and
wrapper helpers that prepend 'gh' (e.g. `_run_gh(["issue", "view", ...])`). ProjectV2
GraphQL mutations inside `gh api graphql` argument literals are reserved to the owner of the
`projects/` prefix below.
Remaining documented blind spots (see the script docstring): command lists with no literal
subcommand, shell-string invocations, and GraphQL documents piped on stdin rather than
passed as arguments.

rationale: Owns the PR ship-ceremony (create / ready / view / merge / close) and read-only GitHub
queries (`gh api` GET for sub-issue graphql, deploy-strategy probing, board-progress
comment preflights). Board-field WRITES are delegated to mission-control's sdlc_manager.py
(the board_writer pattern, #279/#344) — saga never mutates `projects/` directly;
reserved_api_paths backstops the direct REST shape and the ProjectV2 GraphQL mutation names
are reserved to the same owner (#583). Not granted `issue`: issue creation and edit are
mission-control's. saga's issue READS — direct or through the `outcome_github.py` wrapper —
are attributed by the lint and allowed by the read-verb rule, which is how #583 resolved the
former contradiction between this lane and those calls.
The SDLC mutation hub: owns issue lifecycle, project/board field writes (`gh api
projects/...` and ProjectV2 graphql mutations), labels, milestones, and repo metadata.
This is the one plugin authorized to reach the board/status-write surface directly.
Reads deployment + compare state via `gh api` (repos/*/deployments, repos/*/compare).
Mints tags via git, not gh. Must NOT touch issues, PRs, or board projects — those are
mission-control's (issues/boards) and saga's (PR ceremony) to own.
